PRIMARY SUBJECT AND ACTION: A small arctic fox-shaped ice elemental curled into a jagged translucent snowbank, its faceted ears and tail remaining crisp while a cold gust deposits fresh frost over its back. The creature is made of ice rather than freezing flesh. Use three large blue-white facets, no human, fur detail, snow globe or magical protection bubble.
STYLE AND FORMAT: Original fantasy bestiary inventory icon for Immortals Legacy. Simple hand-painted matte gouache, broad brush shapes, few large details, strong silhouette readable at 32px. Muted charcoal, slate, ivory, aged bronze with restrained natural animal colors. Not photorealistic and not an SVG. Entire subject contained with generous transparent margins. Real transparent alpha outside and between subjects. No background, disc, card, white matte, checkerboard, haze, text, numbers or watermark. No generic cultivator or decorative energy swirls. Square icon. Species-appropriate anatomy; do not turn animals into humanoids.
Ability title for context only: Corpo Elemental do Gelo.

entries.name: Corpo Esporado
entries.description: Ao atacar essa criatura, exceto com dano de fogo e ácido, ela libera uma enorme quantidade de esporos que afeta tudo em uma área de 5 metros. Todas as criaturas dentro da área devem realizar uma Salvaguarda de Vontade para não receberem a condição “Envenenado”.

users.name: Fungoides
users.description: Reúne organismos de natureza fúngica, como cogumelos animados, bolores vivos e colônias de esporos, incluindo formas parasitárias ou amaldiçoadas. Resistência: Veneno +6 | Ácido +3 Vulnerabilidade: Fogo -6 | Cortante -3 Deslocamento: Rastejar: 6 m Armaduras: Quitina (8 + Con). Perícias: Proficiências: Sobrevivência, Sobrenatural e Percepção. Salvaguardas: Proficiências: Vontade e Sabedoria. Aspectos: Corpo Esporado, Infestação.

entries.subject: A squat cluster of three thick mushrooms releasing a sudden puff of large pale spores from beneath the largest cap after a pebble strikes its stem. The mushroom remains the main subject and the spore cloud has an irregular compact edge with visible gaps. No human druid, wand, forest background or poison bottle.
entries.rationale: Fungoides liberam esporos ao sofrer ataques; cogumelo atingido e emissão pelas lamelas tornam a reação corporal específica.

entries.subject: A broad-shouldered bull advancing through a snapped rope snare, one foreleg raised free while the broken loop hangs harmlessly from its ankle. Its eye remains fixed ahead and its posture does not falter. Two clean broken rope ends establish resistance to disabling effects, no blood, rage flames, rider or religious symbols.
entries.rationale: Fanático é imunidade a condições de Fortitude e Reflexo em muitos arquétipos; continuar apesar da contenção quebrada mostra obstinação física sem iconografia religiosa inventada.
entries.prompt:
PRIMARY SUBJECT AND ACTION: A broad-shouldered bull advancing through a snapped rope snare, one foreleg raised free while the broken loop hangs harmlessly from its ankle. Its eye remains fixed ahead and its posture does not falter. Two clean broken rope ends establish resistance to disabling effects, no blood, rage flames, rider or religious symbols.
STYLE AND FORMAT: Original fantasy bestiary inventory icon for Immortals Legacy. Simple hand-painted matte gouache, broad brush shapes, few large details, strong silhouette readable at 32px. Muted charcoal, slate, ivory, aged bronze with restrained natural animal colors. Not photorealistic and not an SVG. Entire subject contained with generous transparent margins. Real transparent alpha outside and between subjects. No background, disc, card, white matte, checkerboard, haze, text, numbers or watermark. No generic cultivator or decorative energy swirls. Square icon. Species-appropriate anatomy; do not turn animals into humanoids.
Ability title for context only: Fanático.

entries.prompt:
PRIMARY SUBJECT AND ACTION: An adult female defender standing firm with her guard raised while one oversized frightening shadow face looms immediately before her. Her steady gaze and planted shoulders remain clear above a battered plain shield. Keep fear and resolve in direct confrontation, no physical impact, magic barrier, triumphant pose, flames or background battle.
STYLE AND FORMAT: Original fantasy bestiary inventory icon for Immortals Legacy. Simple hand-painted matte gouache, broad brush shapes, few large details, strong silhouette readable at 32px. Muted charcoal, slate, ivory, aged bronze with restrained natural animal colors. Not photorealistic and not an SVG. Entire subject contained with generous transparent margins. Real transparent alpha outside and between subjects. No background, disc, card, white matte, checkerboard, haze, text, numbers or watermark. No generic cultivator or decorative energy swirls. Square icon. Species-appropriate anatomy; do not turn animals into humanoids.

entries.subject: An empty open gloved hand beneath a straight jian that has been knocked free; a curved saber strikes the guard. Two separate weapon silhouettes and a clear palm-to-hilt gap, no portrait.
entries.rationale: Desarme é comunicado pela mão vazia e pela arma deslocada, com contato na guarda e sem a sobreposição de personagens do ícone anterior.
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: the Disarm ability icon for Immortals Legacy, square transparent inventory art. PRIMARY SUBJECT: a clear close-up of a weapon being knocked out of a hand. Exactly one open leather-gloved hand, one airborne straight Chinese jian sword, and the short curved saber that struck its guard. The jian has visibly LEFT the opponent's open palm: a generous clear gap between the empty fingers and the freed sword grip. The saber contacts only the outer crossguard, flicking the straight sword diagonally upward. Both weapon silhouettes stay separate and easy to distinguish; the empty hand and displaced hilt are the focal point. No faces, no torso, no full fighter. STYLE: simple hand-painted matte gouache, broad confident brush shapes, very few details, chunky steel blades, aged bronze guards, muted charcoal leather and warm ivory edge highlights. Match a restrained Wuxia fantasy icon set, readable at 32 pixels. Entire subject inside the square with generous margins. Genuinely transparent alpha around and between all objects. No background, white slash, mist, rectangular matte, circle, card frame, labels, lettering, numbers or watermark. No glowing ribbons, extra hands, duplicated weapons or fused blades.

The arrow tip is buried precisely in the bullseye; its straight dark wooden shaft projects diagonally toward the lower left, ending in two broad pale feather fletchings and one clear nock. The bullseye and precise central impact remain easy to see. Only the target and the single arrow. STYLE: simple hand-painted matte gouache, broad brush shapes, few large details, strong silhouette readable at 32 pixels. entries.subject: A brown hare twists sideways beneath a passing arrow, its long ears flattened back and all four feet gathering into a tight evasive turn. The arrow crosses above the empty space where its head had been, while one small dust stroke marks the pivot. Use natural physical agility, with no duplicate bodies or teleportation shadows.
entries.rationale: Fugaz e muitos animais usam Esquiva Rápida; o desvio real do projétil mostra evitar dano por reflexo.

The air wall forms one broad angular wedge and the stones clearly lean away from it. Show displacement and collision, without fire, lightning, fists or a circular spell diagram.
STYLE AND FORMAT: Original fantasy bestiary inventory icon for Immortals Legacy. Simple hand-painted matte gouache, broad brush shapes, few large details, strong silhouette readable at 32px. Muted charcoal, slate, ivory, aged bronze with restrained natural animal colors. Not photorealistic and not an SVG. Entire subject contained with generous transparent margins. Real transparent alpha outside and between subjects. No background, disc, card, white matte, checkerboard, haze, text, numbers or watermark. No generic cultivator or decorative energy swirls. Square icon. Species-appropriate anatomy; do not turn animals into humanoids.

entries.name: Salto Mortal
entries.description: Ações: ⬢ [adicional] Ao gastar 2 PQ ao anunciar um ataque ou técnica, a criatura se atira em direção a um alvo a até 10 metros sem consumir deslocamento. Se o alvo for atingido, deve realizar uma Salvaguarda de Fortitude para não ser atirado contra o chão e receber a condição “Caído”, sofrendo 1 dado de dano adicional no processo. entries.subject: A round bronze buckler intercepts an incoming axe while a separate straight jian thrusts out below the shield toward the attacker. Weapons only, no figures or wounds.
entries.rationale: O bloqueio no escudo e a estocada de resposta mostram momentos complementares do contra-ataque.
entries.prompt: PRIMARY SUBJECT: a clean weapon counterattack close-up, with exactly THREE objects and NO hands, people or animal limbs. A small round battered bronze buckler at the upper left catches the head of an incoming dark iron axe with a single small contact chip. Below the buckler, one short straight Chinese jian sword thrusts diagonally outward toward the source of that axe attack. The sword's guard and wrapped grip are visible behind the shield's lower edge; the pointed blade extends freely past the shield toward upper right. Show a shield catching the incoming blow and a distinct answering thrust underneath it. Give the shield, axe and sword three clearly separate silhouettes, avoid overlapping or fused blades. The shield is a physical held object, not a background disc or framing device. Simple matte hand-painted gouache fantasy inventory icon, broad confident brush shapes, very few details, strong silhouette readable at 32 pixels. Wuxia martial style in muted charcoal, warm ivory, aged bronze and natural brown. Not photorealistic, not SVG. Entire subject contained with generous margins in a square. Genuinely transparent alpha around and between objects. No backdrop, haze, white slash, disc used as a frame, card, lettering, numbers, watermark, decorative swirls, glowing ribbons, wounds or blood.

entries.prompt: PRIMARY SUBJECT: Esquiva Elegante, an elegant martial sidestep. Exactly ONE adult female Wuxia martial artist in a simple slate-blue short tunic, ivory sash and dark cloth shoes. Show her full compact figure in a balanced sideways step: weight over one planted foot, the other foot sliding outward, torso turned narrow and leaning gently away from a passing attack. Her arms stay naturally close for balance; two arms, two legs, natural proportions. A single short section of an incoming steel sword enters from the left and passes harmlessly through the EMPTY SPACE in front of her waist. Leave an unmistakable visible gap between blade and body. The attacker is completely outside the icon. Her own hands are empty. A small lifted robe hem reinforces the lateral motion. Small calm face, compact tied hair; the gesture and silhouette matter more than the portrait. STYLE: simple matte hand-painted gouache, broad brush masses, very few details, restrained charcoal, slate blue, warm ivory and aged bronze. Clear silhouette readable at 32 pixels, not photorealistic and not SVG. Entire subject contained inside square with generous margins. Truly transparent alpha around and between subjects. No second person, enemy hand, duplicate/ghost bodies, extra limbs, held sword, magical swirls, motion bands, background, floor scene, frame, circle, haze, lettering, numbers or watermark. entries.prompt:
PRIMARY SUBJECT AND ACTION: A long-eared hare springs upward with all four paws tucked as a compact jagged blast sweeps beneath it. The body arches clear of the dangerous edge, ears streaming backward and hind feet folded tightly. Use one clean airborne oval silhouette and a few blunt debris shapes, with matte paint and transparent margins.
STYLE AND FORMAT: Original fantasy bestiary inventory icon for Immortals Legacy. Simple hand-painted matte gouache, broad brush shapes, few large details, strong silhouette readable at 32px. Muted charcoal, slate, ivory, aged bronze with restrained natural animal colors. Not photorealistic and not an SVG. Entire subject contained with generous transparent margins. Real transparent alpha outside and between subjects. No background, disc, card, white matte, checkerboard, haze, text, numbers or watermark. No generic cultivator or decorative energy swirls. Square icon. Species-appropriate anatomy; do not turn animals into humanoids.
Ability title for context only: Esquiva Rápida.

entries.name: Estilhaço Reativo

Todas as criaturas no interior que falharem em uma Salvaguarda de Fortitude são empurradas por 5 metros na direção contrária à do centro da explosão. Essa habilidade não causa dano de colisão.

PRIMARY SUBJECT: exactly ONE simple open five-petalled flower releasing a sudden soft puff of pollen from its small central stamens. The flower faces mostly forward, with broad warm-ivory petals, a small muted golden center, a short bent stem and two simple dark olive leaves. entries.prompt: Edit this existing painted inventory icon. PRIMARY CORRECTION: replace the wolf's HUMAN-LOOKING HAND AND BARE ARM with a true anatomical WOLF FORELEG AND PAW. The entire limb must have the same gray-white fur as the wolf. The paw is compact and canine: four short rounded toes, broad paw shape and clearly visible dark, sharply tapered curved claws. NO long fingers, human palm, opposable thumb, fingernails or bare human skin. The furry paw rests against the outside of the deer's neck; the claws make gentle nongraphic contact with the fur, without piercing or blood. The foreleg must connect naturally to the wolf's shoulder. SECOND ANATOMY CORRECTION: the deer's small raised limb at lower right must end in an actual compact split CLOVEN HOOF, with two dark horn plates and matching brown fur, not human fingers. Preserve both existing animal heads, deer antlers, expressions, relative positions, warm brown deer, white-gray wolf, small purple paralysis marks, composition and simple matte gouache brushwork. Change only those two incorrect limb anatomies. Keep real transparent alpha outside and between subjects; no new background, frame, haze, text, extra animals or decorative effects. Keep all forms simple and readable in a small game icon.
entries.editPrompt: Correct ONLY the wolf's contact paw in this icon. It is still too hand-shaped. REPLACE that entire hand silhouette with a COMPACT, ROUND CANINE FRONT PAW, roughly as wide as it is long. Four very SHORT stubby furry toes must cluster together like the toes of a dog's front foot, all joined in one broad paw mass. Add four unmistakable DARK CHARCOAL CURVED CLAWS protruding clearly from those toes, large enough to read in a small 256px icon. No human palm, long separated fingers, two-finger gesture, opposable thumb or flat fingernails. This must look like an actual wolf's furry paw, not a human hand covered in fur. The broad underside of the paw presses against the outside of the deer's neck; no gripping or wound. Keep the already corrected furry foreleg and the deer's split hoof unchanged. Preserve both animal heads, antlers, expressions, pose, simple matte painted style, colours and genuinely transparent background. No new limbs, objects, blood, glow, haze, frame or text.
